data.description: Whenever a brijidine uses her meld into stone, soften earth and stone, spike stones, stone shape, or wall of stone spell-like abilities, she can have the affected stone radiate intense heat for 1 minute.  Any creature within 5 feet of the stone takes 1d6 fire damage per round.
data.name: Heat Stone
